sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165270 and /rates (Scan & Pay listing; the catalog is one placeholder site)

values.note: 11 tent-only sites and 8 large RV sites; one RV and up to two tents per site, and all vehicles must fit in the parking spur. No length stated.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground ('The campground offers 11 tent-only sites and eight large recreational vehicle (RV) sites.'; 'A maximum of three tents or one RV and two tents is allowed per site.') + recreation.gov 10165270 notice ('all vehicles must fit in the parking spur'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Bring all water, including enough to put out your campfire. Firewood sold at the host site ($10 a bundle). Next to the Dexter Point boat ramp.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground ('Vault toilets are available in this campground.'; 'No water is available at this campground.'; 'Firewood is available for sale at the host site for $10 per bundle.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov's 2026 fee season (host, fee collection) runs May 22 - Sept 19.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground (Seasons of Use 'Open year-round') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165270/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-19), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Claim a site in person and occupy it the first night; pay by cash, check or money order at the self-service fee tube, or Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only'; 'A self-service fee tube is available. First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the first night.') + recreation.gov 10165270 (Scan and Pay), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 a site, two vehicles included (an RV and its tow count as one; boat/ATV trailers count as a vehicle); third vehicle $11 a night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground ('$26 nightly fee per site ... A third vehicle is an additional $11 per night. RVs and ATV/boat trailers count as one vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165270/rates (2026 WalkInScanPay1 26, same 2027-28), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Leadville RD (Pike-San Isabel NF), concessionaire-run: open sagebrush campground on the north shore of Twin Lakes at Dexter Point, beside the boat ramp, just off paved CO 82 about 20 mi south of Leadville. Mostly tent sites; only 8 take RVs. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 19 sites (11 tent-only + 8 large RV), first-come only, vault toilets, no water, $26 (2026, third vehicle $11), senior discount. Added season (FS: open year-round; fee season May 22 - Sept 19). No length stated anywhere. Pin = the FS point at the Dexter Point parking lot, ~100 m from the high-water line across open sage; lakeview consistent. Willow Fire and Interlaken closures are elsewhere on the district (not Dexter Point). Note trimmed.
flags: Website: stored link is the Pike-San Isabel home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/dexter-campground.
Missing phone: Leadville Ranger District, 719-486-0749 (FS page). recreation.gov's facility contact for the concessionaire is (661) 702-1420.
Rig length: no stated maximum; the FS calls the 8 RV sites 'large recreational vehicle (RV) sites', so no small-rig wording and no CRITERIA problem. Only 8 of 19 sites take an RV.
